Name: Auto Forager (previously Auto Shaker )
Author: Jag3dagster
Description:
AutoForager (previously AutoShaker) is an open-source mod for [url=https://stardewvalley.net/]Stardew Valley[/url] that allows players to automatically shake trees and bushes simply by moving nearby to them.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/beGLdhy.gif[/img]

[size=4][u][b]Documentation
[/b][/u][/size][u][size=3]Overview[/size]
[/u]This mod checks for:
[list]
[*]Bushes that are currently blooming with berries or tea leaves
[list]
[*]NOTE: This includes Golden Walnut bushes[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Fruit trees that currently have fruit on them[/*]
[*]Trees that have a seed available to be shaken down
[list]
[*] NOTE: This includes trees with hazelnuts, coconuts, and golden coconuts[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Forageables throughout Stardew Valley[/*]
[/list]
[size=3][u]Config[/u][/size]
Explanation of config values can be seen [url=https://github.com/Hedgehog-Technologies/StardewMods/edit/main/src/AutoForager/docs/config.md]here on Github

[/url][u]Extensibility[/u]
[list]
[*][size=2]Custom Trees and Fruit Trees should automatically get recognized by the AutoForager[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]If you are a mod maker working on custom Forageable items, to have your item recognized by the Auto Forager, all you need to do is add the context tag "forage_item"﻿﻿ to the item definition[/size]
[list]
[*]Alternatively, you can create a [url=https://github.com/Hedgehog-Technologies/StardewMods/blob/main/src/AutoForager/docs/ContentPack.md]content pack[/url] that can also help to categorize your custom forageables / trees[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list]
